note: A ball (radius 1, mass 1) drops from 5 m onto a fixed box ground whose top is at y = 0, with a CollisionCollection of bounce 0 and no friction. The world settles with the ball's centre 1 above the ground, in both engines. A page that writes the position gets it taken up; enabled false stops all stepping.
gaps: the bridge engine is its own: sequential impulses at 240 Hz, spheres and boxes (cylinder and cone stand in as bounding spheres), one friction and bounce for the whole collection
autoDisable, disableTime and the disable speeds are kept but never put a body to sleep
centerOfMass is kept and not used; joints come in their own batch
contactSurfaceThickness, preferAccuracy and set_contacts are kept; CollisionSensor/Contact nodes come later
